en.title: Colecium Tablet
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to supply vitamin D and B1 during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, and periods of reduced strength during or after illness, as well as in growth and old age, and to prevent poor development of bones and teeth and rickets.
en.usage: Adults take 1 tablet at a time, once a day. Follow the prescribed dosage.
en.caution: Warning: do not take this medicine if you have hypercalcemia (excess calcium in the blood), sarcoidosis (a systemic inflammatory disease of unknown cause), kidney disease, hypersensitivity to this medicine, kidney stones, or severe renal failure, or if the user is an infant under 12 months. Consult a pharmacist before use if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, are breastfeeding, or are a premature or young infant, or if you have cardiac or circulatory dysfunction, kidney impairment, low blood protein, are taking cardiac glycosides, or have a history of kidney stones. If there is no improvement after about a month of use, stop immediately and consult a pharmacist. Do not take this medicine together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracyclines, or antacids. Consult a pharmacist if taking it with anti-aldosterone agents or triamterene. Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea and black tea during, before, and after use. Stop immediately and consult a pharmacist if nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loose stools, constipation, low blood pressure, facial flushing, irregular heartbeat, or skin rash appears.

en.title: Medidase Tablet
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for indigestion, loss of appetite (anorexia), overeating, an upset stomach, promotion of digestion, and abdominal fullness due to indigestion.
en.usage: Those aged 15 or over take 2 tablets at a time; those aged 11 to under 15 take 1 1/3 tablets at a time; those aged 8 to under 11 take 1 tablet at a time, 3 times a day after meals. Follow the prescribed dosage.
en.caution: Do not take this medicine if the user is a child aged 7 or under, or has a hereditary problem such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption. Consult a pharmacist before use if you have an allergic constitution, or are hypersensitive to Yellow No. 4 or have such a history. If there is no improvement after about 2 weeks of use, stop immediately and consult a pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage. When giving to a child, administer under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.

en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to supply vitamins A, B1, B2, B6, and C and zinc during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, and reduced strength during or after illness, and to relieve neuralgia, muscle pain, joint pain (low back pain, stiff shoulders, etc.), angular cheilitis, cheilitis, stomatitis, glossitis, eczema, dermatitis, dry eyes, night blindness, beriberi, and eye fatigue.
en.usage: Those aged 12 or over and adults take 1 tablet at a time, once a day after a meal. Follow the prescribed dosage.
en.caution: Warning: taking 5,000 IU or more of vitamin A a day may cause birth defects. Women within the first 3 months of pregnancy or who may be pregnant must not take this medicine. Do not take it together with phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracyclines, antacids, or levodopa. Consult a pharmacist if taking it with cardiac glycosides, anti-aldosterone agents, or triamterene. Avoid tannin-containing teas such as green tea and black tea during, before, and after use. Stop immediately and consult a pharmacist if nausea, vomiting, itching, dry rough skin, painful joint swelling, diarrhea, loose stools, constipation, low blood pressure, facial flushing, irregular heartbeat, skin rash, red spots, cardiac arrest, central nervous system depression, dermatitis, body or breath odor, hair loss, restlessness, gastrointestinal disorder, indigestion, upper abdominal pain, or pulmonary edema appears.

If there is no improvement after about a month of use, stop immediately and consult a pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage. This medicine may interfere with the detection of glucose in various urine tests. While taking this medicine, do not take phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracyclines, or antacids. en.title: Codvita Soft Capsule
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used to supply vitamins A, B1, and B2 during physical fatigue, pregnancy and breastfeeding, reduced strength during or after illness, and old age, to relieve dry eyes and night blindness, to relieve neuralgia, muscle pain, joint pain (low back pain, stiff shoulders, etc.), angular cheilitis, cheilitis, stomatitis, glossitis, eczema, and dermatitis, and to relieve beriberi and eye fatigue.
en.usage: Those aged 8 or over and adults take 2 capsules at a time, twice a day. Follow the prescribed dosage.
en.caution: Warning: taking 5,000 IU or more of vitamin A a day may cause birth defects. Women within the first 3 months of pregnancy or who may be pregnant must not take this medicine. Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, or if the user is an infant under 3 months, or if you have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to soybean oil, or are hypersensitive to soybeans or peanuts. Consult a pharmacist before use if the user is an infant under 1 year, or if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, are breastfeeding, are a premature or young infant, have a fat-metabolism disorder such as hyperlipoproteinemia, diabetic hyperlipidemia, or pancreatitis, are a patient in whom lipid emulsions must be given cautiously, or have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to Red No. 40. Follow the prescribed dosage. When giving to a child, administer under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Stop immediately and consult a pharmacist if nausea, vomiting, itching, dry rough skin, painful joint swelling, loose stools, diarrhea, constipation, loss of appetite, erythema (red spots), hives, eczema, rash, maculopapular rash, itching, edema, or fluid retention (in patients with renal or heart failure) appears, or if there is no improvement after about a month of use.

content_json.efficacy: 소화불량, 식욕감퇴(식욕부진), 과식, 체함, 소화촉진, 소화불량으로 인한 위부(상복부)팽만감에 사용하는 일반의약품입니다.
content_json.usage:
만 15세 이상 및 성인은 1회 2정씩, 1일 3회 식후에 복용합니다.
정해진 용법·용량을 지키세요.
content_json.caution:
다음 분은 복용하지 마세요. 만 7세 이하의 어린이, 대두유에 과민증 환자, 알레르기 반응 경험자, 콩 또는 땅콩에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 복용하지 마세요.

복용 전 약사와 상의하세요. 이 약을 복용하기 전에 알레르기 체질, 고지단백혈증, 당뇨병성고지질혈증 및 췌장염 등 지방대사 이상 환자 또는 지질성 유제를 신중히 투여해야 하는 환자는 약사와 상의하세요. 2주 정도 투여하여도 증상의 개선이 없을 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 약사와 상의하세요.

정해진 용법과 용량을 잘 지키세요.
content_json.ingredientSelection:
제품에 따라 성분 구성과 함량이 다를 수 있으니, 지병이나 복용 중인 약이 있으면 매장의 약사에게 확인하세요.
증상이 지속되거나 궁금한 점이 있으면 매장 내 약사 등 전문가와 상담하세요.

en.title: Beatin Tablet
en.efficacy: An over-the-counter medicine used for indigestion, loss of appetite (anorexia), overeating, an upset stomach, promotion of digestion, and upper-abdominal fullness due to indigestion.
en.usage: Those aged 15 or over and adults take 2 tablets at a time, 3 times a day after meals. Follow the prescribed dosage.
en.caution: Do not take this medicine if the user is a child aged 7 or under, is hypersensitive to soybean oil, has experienced an allergic reaction, or is hypersensitive to soybeans or peanuts. Consult a pharmacist before use if you have an allergic constitution, or a fat-metabolism disorder such as hyperlipoproteinemia, diabetic hyperlipidemia, or pancreatitis, or are a patient in whom lipid emulsions must be given cautiously. If there is no improvement after about 2 weeks of use, stop immediately and consult a pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage.

summaryTable.How it works: A digestive that aids digestion
summaryTable.Main symptoms: Indigestion, loss of appetite, overeating, upset stomach, upper-abdominal fullness
